evals.prompt: I have an idea: a recipe-sharing site with social features, meal planning, grocery integration, and premium subscriptions. Help me scope the MVP.
evals.expected_output: One thin slice with an explicit out-of-scope list and a success metric.
expectations: Proposes a thin end-to-end slice (post + discover a recipe) rather than all features
Has an explicit Out of scope section deferring meal planning, grocery, and payments
Names one success metric with a target
Gives one sequenced recommendation rather than a menu
Does not include backend-only milestones with no user-visible effect

evals.prompt: Write user stories for clinic appointment booking: patients book, receptionists manage, reminders go out.
evals.expected_output: Demoable stories with acceptance criteria including sad paths.
expectations: Each story is independently demoable by a user
Acceptance criteria are observable by a non-engineer
Includes sad-path criteria (double booking, failed reminder)
Each story has an out-of-scope line and a size

evals.prompt: How long will it take to build a marketplace with chat, payments, reviews, and an admin panel? We need a date for investors.
evals.expected_output: Ranges with confidence, unknowns as spikes, and date-driven scope trade.
expectations: Gives ranges, not a single date, with a confidence note
Turns unknowns into time-boxed spikes rather than padding
Offers date-driven scoping (fix the date, flex the scope)
Never commits to a calendar date for unresolved work

evals.prompt: Prioritize these for v1: SSO, audit logs, dark mode, CSV export, mobile app, API webhooks.
evals.expected_output: MoSCoW with most items deferred and revisit triggers.
expectations: Puts most items in Won't with a revisit trigger each
Forces at most one or two Must items with the reason stated
Judges by user value, not by effort size
Gives one ordered recommendation

evals.prompt: Write a PRD for an internal HR tool: employee records, roles, reports.
evals.expected_output: A complete PRD following the template with scope in/out and risks.
expectations: Follows the PRD template (problem, users, metric, scope, risks, questions)
Has exactly one success metric plus a counter-metric
Out-of-scope items each carry a revisit trigger
Risks name a spike or decision that retires each

evals.prompt: Should our MVP include multi-tenancy? We might sell to enterprises later.
evals.expected_output: Defers multi-tenancy with the trigger for revisiting.
expectations: Says no for the MVP with the cost reason (complexity tax on every story)
Names the revisit trigger (first enterprise prospect)
Proposes the cheapest reversible step instead (e.g. org_id column, single-tenant deploys)
Does not design the full multi-tenant architecture now

evals.prompt: Plan the releases after our booking MVP: payments, reminders, analytics, mobile app.
evals.expected_output: Risk-first sequencing with user-visible outcomes per release.
expectations: Orders by risk times value, not by ease
Each release has a user-visible outcome
No infrastructure-only Sprint 0 longer than a week
States what assumption each release retires

evals.prompt: Everything on our backlog is marked Must. Help.
evals.expected_output: Forces the ordering with the 60% rule and pushes back.
expectations: Pushes back: three top priorities means no priorities
Applies the Must budget (roughly 60% of effort) to force cuts
Moves items to Should/Could/Won't with reasons
Ends with one ordered list, not a menu
